if Shop1EnhanceManager == nil then
    Shop1EnhanceManager = class({})
end

Shop1EnhanceManager.states = Shop1EnhanceManager.states or {}
Shop1EnhanceManager._event_registered = Shop1EnhanceManager._event_registered or false

Shop1EnhanceManager.config = Shop1EnhanceManager.config or {
    choice_count = 3,
    pick_time = 10,
}

local RESERVED_KEYS = {
    Open = true,
    Stacks = true,
    Name = true,
    Desc = true,
    Description = true,
    Image = true,
    AbilityImage = true,
    Title = true,
}

local GENERIC_TO_PREFIX = {
    Interval = true,
    Range = true,
    BaseDamage = true,
    Level = true,
    PurePercent = true,
    DummyMode = true,
}

local function ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local num = tonumber(s)
    if num then
        return num
    end

    local nums = ParseArray(s)
    if #nums > 0 then
        return nums[math.min(level, #nums)]
    end

    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #strs > 0 then
        return strs[math.min(level, #strs)]
    end

    return s
end

local function GetItemFieldValue(kv, key, level)
    if not kv or not key then
        return nil
    end
    local raw = kv[key]
    if raw == nil or raw == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local tokens = ParseStringArray(tostring(raw))
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level or 1, #tokens)]
    end
    return raw
end

local function ApplyEnhanceConfig(overrides, cfg, level, context_prefix)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end

    for key, value in pairs(cfg) do
        if key == "BonusAttribute" and type(value) == "table" then
            for attr_key, attr_val in pairs(value) do
                local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(attr_val, level)
                if resolved ~= nil then
                    overrides[attr_key] = resolved
                end
            end
        elseif not RESERVED_KEYS[key] then
            local target_key = key
            if context_prefix and GENERIC_TO_PREFIX[key] then
                target_key = context_prefix .. key
            end

            local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(value, level)
            if resolved ~= nil then
                overrides[target_key] = resolved
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceKV()
    local kv = Shop1EnhanceKV or {}
    if kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"] then
        kv = kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"]
    end
    return kv
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV()
    return kv and kv[name] or nil
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return 1
    end
    local stacks = tonumber(cfg.Stacks or 1) or 1
    if stacks < 1 then
        stacks = 1
    end
    return stacks
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return false
    end
    return tonumber(cfg.Open or 0) == 1
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:EnsureState(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return nil
    end
    if not self.states[pid] then
        self.states[pid] = {
            pool_list = {},
            pool_map = {},
            purchased = {},
            selection = nil,
        }
    end
    return self.states[pid]
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_request", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_choice", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_giveup", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceGiveUp(event)
    end)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:InitPlayer(pid)
    self:EnsureState(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return 0
    end
    return state.purchased[name] or 0
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SetPurchasedCount(pid, name, count)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    state.purchased[name] = count
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name)
    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or not name or name == "" or name == "none" then
        return false
    end

    if state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        return false
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
    if purchased >= stacks then
        return false
    end

    table.insert(state.pool_list, name)
    state.pool_map[name] = true
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return false
    end
    if not state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end
    state.pool_map[name] = nil

    for i = #state.pool_list, 1, -1 do
        if state.pool_list[i] == name then
            table.remove(state.pool_list, i)
            break
        end
    end
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPoolList(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state then
        return {}
    end
    return state.pool_list
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsUnlocked(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return true
    end
    if not SpawnWallManager or not SpawnWallManager.GetExpansionProgress then
        return true
    end
    local _, _, count = SpawnWallManager:GetExpansionProgress(pid)
    count = tonumber(count or 0) or 0
    return count >= 5
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    local pool_count = (state and state.pool_list and #state.pool_list) or 0
    return {
        unlocked = self:IsUnlocked(pid),
        available = pool_count > 0,
        pool_count = pool_count,
    }
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(pid, raw_item_name, level)
    if not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end

    local kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name]
    if not kv then
        return false
    end

    local changed = false
    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1

    local proj = GetItemFieldValue(kv, "ProjectileName", lvl)
    if proj and proj ~= "" and proj ~= "none" then
        changed = self:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, proj) or changed
    end

    local sp = GetItemFieldValue(kv, "ProjectileSP", lvl)
    if sp and sp ~= "" and sp ~= "none" then
        changed = self:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, sp) or changed
    end

    local sp2 = GetItemFieldValue(kv, "ProjectileSP2", lvl)
    if sp2 and sp2 ~= "" and sp2 ~= "none" then
        changed = self:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, sp2) or changed
    end

    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, raw_item_name, level, kv)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not raw_item_name then
        return nil
    end

    local item_kv = kv or (Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name])
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local overrides = {}
    local applied = false

    local function apply_for(projectile_name, context_prefix)
        if not projectile_name or projectile_name == "" or projectile_name == "none" then
            return
        end

        local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(projectile_name)
        if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
            return
        end

        local count = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, projectile_name)
        if count <= 0 then
            return
        end

        local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
        local enhance_level = math.min(count, stacks)
        ApplyEnhanceConfig(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, context_prefix)
        applied = true
    end

    apply_for(GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileName", lvl), "Projectile")
    apply_for(GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileSP", lvl), "ProjectileSP")
    apply_for(GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileSP2", lvl), "ProjectileSP2")

    if not applied then
        return nil
    end

    return overrides
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildChoicePayload(name)
    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name) or {}

    local payload = {
        ability = name or "",
        image = cfg.Image or "",
        ability_image = cfg.AbilityImage or "",
        display_name = cfg.Name or "",
        display_desc = cfg.Desc or cfg.Description or "",
    }

    if payload.image == "" and name and name ~= "" then
        payload.image = "s2r://panorama/images/spellicons/" .. name .. "_png.vtex"
    end

    return payload
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:StartSelection(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    if not self:IsUnlocked(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or state.selection then
        return
    end

    local pool = state.pool_list
    if not pool or #pool == 0 then
        return
    end

    local temp_pool = {}
    for i, name in ipairs(pool) do
        temp_pool[i] = name
    end

    local choices = {}
    local count = self.config.choice_count or 3

    for i = 1, count do
        if #temp_pool > 0 then
            local idx = RandomInt(1, #temp_pool)
            local name = temp_pool[idx]
            choices[i] = name
            table.remove(temp_pool, idx)
        else
            choices[i] = nil
        end
    end

    local now = GameRules:GetGameTime()
    local end_time = now + (self.config.pick_time or 10)

    state.selection = {
        choices = choices,
        end_time = end_time,
    }

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if player then
        local payload = {
            player_id = pid,
            time_limit = math.max(end_time - now, 0),
            choice_count = count,
            title = "#shop1_enhance_pick_title",
            choices = {},
        }

        for i = 1, count do
            local name = choices[i]
            if name and name ~= "" then
                payload.choices[i] = self:BuildChoicePayload(name)
            else
                payload.choices[i] = {
                    ability = "",
                    image = "s2r://panorama/images/hero_selection/empty_hero_card_png.vtex",
                    ability_image = "",
                }
            end
        end

        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_show", payload)
    end

    Timers:CreateTimer("Shop1Enhance_Pick_" .. tostring(pid), {
        useGameTime = true,
        endTime = self.config.pick_time or 10,
        callback = function()
            local st = self.states[pid]
            if st and st.selection then
                self:ClearSelection(pid)
            end
        end
    })
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ClearSelection(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if state then
        state.selection = nil
    end

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if player then
        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_close", {
            player_id = pid,
        })
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    self:StartSelection(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    local idx = tonumber(event.choice_index or -1)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not state.selection then
        return
    end

    if idx < 1 then
        return
    end

    local choice = state.selection.choices and state.selection.choices[idx]
    if not choice or choice == "" then
        return
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(choice)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        self:ClearSelection(pid)
        return
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, choice) + 1
    if purchased > stacks then
        purchased = stacks
    end
    self:SetPurchasedCount(pid, choice, purchased)

    if purchased >= stacks then
        self:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, choice)
    end

    self:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)

    self:ClearSelection(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceGiveUp(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end
    self:ClearSelection(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.RefreshItemsForEnhance then
        return
    end

    mgr:RefreshItemsForEnhance()

    if mgr.SyncToClient then
        mgr:SyncToClient()
    end
end

payload.text:
**Implementing pipe-separated multi-value parsing**

I’m updating the enhancement manager to support fields that include multiple values separated by `|`, like additional projectiles and passives. I'll add helper functions to split these values and map them to multiple slots accordingly, ensuring that enhancements can properly handle multiple projectiles or passives as indicated in the config instructions. This will align the parsing with the documented format and extend functionality beyond single-value fields.

+local function SplitByPipe(raw)
+    local list = {}
+    if raw == nil then
+        return list
+    end
+    local s = tostring(raw)
+    for token in string.gmatch(s, "[^|]+") do
+        local trimmed = string.gsub(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
+        if trimmed ~= "" then
+            table.insert(list, trimmed)
+        end
+    end
+    return list
+end
+
+local function GetPipeValue(raw, index)
+    local list = SplitByPipe(raw)
+    if #list == 0 then
+        return raw
+    end
+    local idx = math.min(index or 1, #list)
+    return list[idx]
+end

**Planning snippet-based dynamic UI construction**

This is a big one! I'm thinking through how to replace static shop panels with snippet-based dynamic creation in XML and JavaScript. I want to load snippets in JS via BLoadLayoutSnippet, assign unique IDs or store references to avoid conflicts, and update UI logic to work with these dynamic panels. I'll refactor shop1_panel.xml to have a container panel and snippet definitions, then build slots and buttons dynamically in JS, managing references instead of global IDs. This should let the shop UI add buttons flexibly while avoiding ID collisions. It's a careful balance between XML snippet usage and JavaScript dynamic construction—I'll implement by removing static panels, adding snippets, and creating everything in JS with safe references!
